title: Sliding window
summary: Longest run of text with no repeated character. On a repeat, jump left past that character's last index; max() ignores sightings already left of the window. O(n).
code: # Keep a window with no repeated characters.
triggers: longest or shortest contiguous substring or subarray under a constraint
'no repeats', 'at most k distinct', 'at most k changes'
prompts: A badge reader logs door codes in order. Find the longest stretch of consecutive swipes in which no code appears twice.
A radio station never repeats a song within one block. Given the play history, how long is the longest block that already obeys that rule?
invariant: text[left:right + 1] has no repeated character, and last_seen maps each character to its latest index so far.
mantra: Expand right; on a repeat, jump left past its last sighting, never backwards.
pitfalls: Without max(left, ...), a sighting from before the window drags left backwards ('abba').
Record last_seen[char] after moving left, or every character collides with itself.
The window holds right - left + 1 characters.

anchors.name: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
anchors.trick: Exactly this: last-seen map plus jump.

anchors.name: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
anchors.trick: Shrink variant: valid while window length - top count <= k.

mutations.explanation: Without max(), a repeat seen before the window moves left backwards and admits duplicates: 'abba' gives 3.
Off by one: the window from left to right holds right - left + 1 characters.
